svg.title: Gatekit held-out eval by case type
svg.desc: Bar chart of held-out eval results by case type. Ordinary actions: 84 of 84 correct, 0 of 30 gated actions allowed. Action not in the catalog: 5 of 5 correct, 0 of 5 gated actions allowed. Name at a rule boundary: 7 of 7 correct, 0 of 2 gated actions allowed. Unexpected target format: 5 of 14 correct, 6 of 12 gated actions allowed. Agent under-reports risk: 2 of 10 correct, 8 of 10 gated actions allowed.
svg.text: Held-out decisions by case type: 103/120 correct, 14 of 59 gated actions let through
Bar length: cases. Green: correct decision. Red: should have been denied or held, was allowed. Amber: other wrong decision.
